title: How to Send the Right Job Application Link on WhatsApp
summary: Send WhatsApp applicants to the right CV upload form. See real iPhone replies for open and closed jobs, then match a sample receipt to the organizer’s record.
body_markdown:
Two job posters for the fictional Rivet Arts Fair are still on the café wall. The ticket desk needs a weekend hire. The crew that hangs the posters has filled its last place. Both posters give applicants the same WhatsApp number.


We asked about both jobs in one WhatsApp chat. **“I saw the ticket desk poster. Where do I send my CV?”** got a direct link to the application. “Is the poster crew still hiring?” got the vacancies board. The next day we opened the ticket-desk link on the same iPhone, submitted the fair’s sample CV and found the applicant’s reference on an organizer record marked **Received** .


One chat, two destinations. The first reply links to **/ticket-desk** . The second directs the applicant to current vacancies.


Where the first link took us. The page names **Ticket Desk Assistant** before it asks for a CV.


[Try the ticket-desk form](https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/rivet-arts-fair/ticket-desk) to get your own receipt. It comes with a sample CV, and you can open the organizer’s copy in the same tab. The steps below show how toteach the agent which link to send andtest the reply on WhatsApp .


## 1. Which application page should the WhatsApp reply open?


Give each open job a direct mobile link. A recruiting homepage makes the applicant search for the job a second time. At Rivet, the hiring desk keeps three destinations handy.


When someone asks about… Send them here


The open Ticket Desk Assistant role The application form headed **Ticket Desk Assistant**


A job at the fair in general, or the closed Poster Crew role The[current vacancies board](https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/rivet-arts-fair)


Help with a previous application The[hiring desk](https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/rivet-arts-fair/help) , open Monday from 10:00 to 12:00, fair local time


See the full vacancies board


The closed-role reply gives the applicant the fair’s vacancies link. On that page, only the ticket desk still has an application.


For your own hiring desk, open each destination on a signed-out phone. Read the heading before you touch the file control. If two roles land on the same blank form, give each one a link that preserves the job selection, or send the vacancies list so the applicant can choose.


## 2. How do you give Quickchat AI the current vacancies?


Keep the job status and its URL in the same Knowledge Base article. You’ll edit that article when a position fills. The instructions about how to answer can stay the same.


1. [Create a Quickchat AI account](https://app.quickchat.ai/register) or open your workspace. In an existing workspace, choose **Add new AI Agent** so you have a separate practice Agent. Choose **Set up manually** , name it **Rivet Arts Fair** and give it the job of helping applicants find the fair’s open roles. Finish onboarding to reach the dashboard.
2. In the sidebar, open **AI Agent → Knowledge Base → Add Article** . Enter` Rivet Arts Fair hiring notice` in **Title** . Paste the notice below into **Content** . The URLs open the practice portal. Use your employer’s approved URLs when adapting it for a real vacancy.
3. Click **Save** . In the article list, wait for **Ready** before opening Preview. Quickchat AI processes the change automatically.[Knowledge Base article status](https://quickchat.ai/docs/ai-agent/knowledge-base#article-status)


```text
Ticket Desk Assistant | Open
Weekend shifts at the fair ticket desk. Apply and upload your CV or résumé on this form:
https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/rivet-arts-fair/ticket-desk


Poster Crew | Closed
Applications have closed. There is no application form for this role.


Current vacancies
For all openings, including when a role is closed or unspecified:
https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/rivet-arts-fair


Hiring desk
Monday, 10:00 to 12:00, fair local time. For applicant help:
https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/rivet-arts-fair/help
```


See the job records in the article editor


The article holds the facts the hiring desk can change.


## 3. What should the agent say about an open or closed job?


We started with two sentences in the Main Prompt.


> Help applicants for Rivet Arts Fair. Check the hiring notice and send the application link.


The agent found the right form for someone who named the ticket desk. It sent **the very same form** to someone who only asked, “Are there any jobs at the fair?” That applicant had never picked a job.


We tried the same question in a fresh conversation with an explicit rule for unnamed roles. This time the applicant got the vacancies board. Both versions already handled the closed Poster Crew role.


**“Send the application link.”** The agent picked the ticket desk for the applicant.


**“No role named.”** The applicant gets to choose from the current openings.


In **AI Agent → Identity → AI Persona** , click **Edit** beside **Main Prompt** . Paste the following instructions. The editor saves your changes automatically.[Main Prompt settings](https://quickchat.ai/docs/ai-agent/identity#main-prompt)


```text
Help applicants for Rivet Arts Fair. For each question, check the hiring notice.
Open role: name the role and share its exact application URL.
Closed role: say applications are closed and share the current vacancies page.
No role named: share the current vacancies page. Never guess a role or invent a link.
Ask applicants to use the form for their CV or résumé. Never ask for a file or personal details in chat.
Only the hiring portal can confirm a submission or its status. For help, use the hiring desk details in the notice.
```


The prompt refers to the hiring notice. The next time a role changes, there is one place to update its link.


Close the editor, set **Reply Length** to **Short** , and open **AI Preview** . Send` I saw the ticket desk poster. Where do I send my CV?` Open the answer’s link and check the job heading. In our test it led to **Ticket Desk Assistant** , the form pictured at the start.


Try the other branches in fresh conversations. An earlier mention of the ticket desk could otherwise change which link you get.


Applicant’s message What to look for


“Are there any jobs at the fair?” A link to the vacancies board. The reply leaves the role choice to the applicant.


“Is the poster crew still hiring?” Closed status and the board link. No retired application URL.


“Can I send my CV here in WhatsApp?” Instructions to use the portal and a link to the vacancies board, since the applicant hasn’t named a role.


“I tapped the link. Does that mean I have applied?” Directions to check the portal confirmation or ask the hiring desk. The agent has no access to a submission record in this setup.


If you manage your Agent from ChatGPT or Claude, you can give a connected Quickchat AI account the notice and prompt above. Ask it to prepare the practice Agent and show you its answer for Poster Crew. The owner of the number completes Meta’s sign-in in the next step.[Manage Quickchat AI from an AI app](https://quickchat.ai/docs/manage-with-ai)


## 4. How do you test the application link on WhatsApp?


Use a business number you control and a second WhatsApp account for the applicant. For a business deployment you’ll need a suitable commercial Quickchat AI plan, AI credits and access to the Meta business portfolio that owns the number.[WhatsApp channel setup](https://quickchat.ai/docs/channels/whatsapp)


**Open Meta from the hiring Agent.** In Quickchat AI, go to **Channels → External Apps → WhatsApp** . Choose the option that describes your number and click **Connect WhatsApp** . If you already use the number in the WhatsApp Business app and want to keep using the app, follow the[Coexistence setup](https://quickchat.ai/post/whatsapp-business-auto-reply-ai#what-is-whatsapp-coexistence-and-can-you-keep-the-app) . For our test number, Meta opened in a second window. Click **Continue** there.


See where to choose the number type in Quickchat AI


If the signup window disappears, choose **Open the Meta window again** in Quickchat AI.


**Choose the number applicants will message.** Sign in to Meta and select the appropriate business portfolio and WhatsApp Business Account. On **Add your WhatsApp phone number** , our existing test number appeared with a green **Registered** badge. Choose your number, check its display name, then review the business, WhatsApp account and messaging account. In this signup flow, **Next** advances from the permissions screen.


The registered number was already available in Meta’s list.


Check all three entries belong to the business running the job ad.


Our first attempt returned **WhatsApp Business already connected elsewhere** . Its WhatsApp Business Account was still linked to another Quickchat AI Agent. If you manage both Agents, match the business account ID in the error to the old Agent’s WhatsApp panel. Check which numbers it serves before choosing **Disconnect** , which releases the whole WhatsApp Business Account. Then return to the hiring Agent and retry.


**Send the first applicant message.** Meta showed **Your account is connected to Quickchat AI** . Back on the hiring Agent, WhatsApp showed **Enabled** and **Waiting for your first message** . If Quickchat AI asks you to choose between accounts, select the one containing your number and click **Use this account** .


See how to return if the confirmation window stays open


**Webhook Active** and **Admin Assigned** were already green while the number was waiting for its first message.


From the second phone, send` I saw the ticket desk poster. Where do I send my CV?` When the reply arrives, tap its link and check that the page opens on **Ticket Desk Assistant** . Back in Quickchat AI, click **Refresh** and look for **AI reply delivered** beside the number. WhatsApp confirmed delivery of both replies pictured at the top of this guide. You can also open **Conversations → Inbox** to check the question and the exact URL the Agent sent.[Quickchat AI Inbox](https://quickchat.ai/docs/conversations/inbox)


For a poster, encode a click-to-chat link into its QR code. Replace` BUSINESS_NUMBER` with the full international number, digits only. Scanning fills in a draft message. The applicant taps **Send** .[WhatsApp’s click-to-chat format](https://faq.whatsapp.com/5913398998672934)


```text
https://wa.me/BUSINESS_NUMBER?text=Is%20the%20ticket%20desk%20still%20hiring%3F
```


For a Facebook or Instagram ad, choose the same WhatsApp number as the messaging destination. Preview the ad, open the chat and check that the draft message names the job. The applicant can edit it before sending.[Meta’s ads that click to WhatsApp](https://whatsappbusiness.com/products/ads-that-click-to-whatsapp/)


## 5. How do you know the application arrived?


Look for the same reference on the applicant’s receipt and in the organizer’s record. WhatsApp’s delivery status tells you the reply reached the phone. The hiring portal tells you whether an application arrived.


On the **Ticket Desk Assistant** form, tap **Use sample CV** . The form supplies a fictional PDF called` rivet-sample-cv.pdf` . You can open it with **Read the sample PDF** .


1. Tap **Submit sample application** . Under **Application received** , find the reference beginning with` RVT-` .
2. Tap **Open organizer view** in the same tab. Compare the reference, vacancy and filename with the receipt, then check the status.


The applicant’s iPhone receipt for the ticket desk. Our sample got **RVT-CC1A-B37A** . Yours will have its own reference.


The organizer sees **RVT-CC1A-B37A** too, with the same PDF and the status **Received** .


The demo keeps the practice record in the tab that submitted it. To try a second application, tap **Start a new sample** , select the sample CV again and compare the new reference. For a real hiring portal, submit a synthetic CV to a test vacancy and look up the matching record in the employer’s applicant tracking system.


## 6. What should an old job poster open after the role closes?


Keep the role name in the notice so someone with the old poster still gets a specific answer. Once the fair fills the ticket desk, the useful destination becomes the vacancies board.


1. In a real closure, stop accepting submissions in the hiring portal and update the board first. For this rehearsal, edit your **practice Agent** . Change the ticket-desk heading in the hiring notice to` Ticket Desk Assistant | Closed` . Remove its application URL and replace the weekend-shift sentence with` Applications have closed. There is no application form for this role.`
2. Save and wait for **Ready** . Start a new Preview conversation and send the exact ticket-desk question from step 3. Look for closed status and the vacancies board. Follow the link to make sure it opens the list.
3. Restore the open record when you finish. The reversal is worth testing because an old poster and an old WhatsApp reply age differently. A new message gets today’s answer. A saved link still goes directly to the form, where the portal decides whether applications are open.


We asked the original question again. The reply began “Applications for Ticket Desk Assistant are closed.” Its only link opened the vacancies board.


## Frequently asked questions


### How do I send a job application link on WhatsApp?


List each job and its status in your hiring notice, with the exact application URL for every open role. When someone messages your WhatsApp Business number about an open role, have the agent name it and reply with its mobile application form. Test the link from the applicant’s phone.


### What if the WhatsApp message doesn’t name a job?


Send the current vacancies page. Give the applicant a chance to choose a job before sending a role-specific CV upload form.


### Where should applicants send a CV or résumé?


Direct applicants to the employer’s application form. If someone offers to attach a CV in WhatsApp, give them the form for their chosen role. Applicants who haven’t chosen a role can start on the vacancies page.


### What happens when someone responds to an old job ad?


Keep the closed job’s name in the hiring notice, mark it closed and remove its application URL. The agent can recognize the job named in the message, explain that applications have closed and point to current openings.


### How can I tell whether a WhatsApp applicant finished applying?


Match the applicant’s confirmation reference to a submission for that role in your hiring portal. WhatsApp delivery confirms the reply reached the phone. A tap opens the form. Your portal records the completed application.


### Can a poster and a click-to-WhatsApp ad use the same hiring number?


Yes. Point the poster’s click-to-chat link and the ad’s WhatsApp destination to the same authorized business number. A prefilled role name gives the applicant a useful first message. The hiring notice decides which link is current when they send it.
